# P38.1b — Round-11 gap analysis, sub-rounds 11C + 11D, and the composed two-sum headline (CAP-lite second half)

Independent, fresh-context re-read of every 11C + 11D row's declared acceptance
criteria against the landed evidence. This is the analysis artifact for manifest
row 502 (`docs/tickets/502_P38.1b__round11-gap-analysis-11c-11d-and-composed-verification.md`).
Sibling P38.1a (row 501, `docs/build/reports/p38.1a-gap-analysis-11a-11b.md`)
owns 11A + 11B and its share of the two-sum; this file carries the 11C + 11D
share and **completes the composed Round-11 headline** — the acceptance input
P38.2 and GATE-ACCEPT-R11 read. Read-only: `live_verification=false`, no
production mutation, no live leg executed by this row.

## 0. Method and independence

- Scope: BUILD_INDEX physical rows 344–500 inclusive — **162 rows** (77 rows in
  11C ending GATE-G6 row 420, including the inserted/late rows `489a`–`489e` is
  an 11D note — see below; 85 rows in 11D rows 421–500), including plan row
  PLAN-11D (418), capstone rows P36.73 (419) and P37.68d (500), gate marker
  GATE-G6 (420), and the RULING-inserted rows `489a` P37.61a (PR #517),
  `489b` P37.61b (PR #518), `489c` P37.61c (PR #519), `489d` P37.61d (PR #520),
  `489e` P37.61e (PR #521).
- Evidence re-read per row, not copied from the rows' own self-assessments:
  `docs/build/BUILD_INDEX.md` status cells; the per-ticket run ledgers under
  `docs/build/runs/` (every one of the 161 non-marker rows' ledgers verified
  present; gate markers keep their `readouts/` record instead);
  `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` status cells (278 rows parsed, 190 OPEN
  file-wide, 94 OPEN tied to in-scope tickets); the obligation event chain
  `docs/build/reports/obligations/events.jsonl` (794 events / 515 assessments,
  `obligation_events.py check` green at this read); the committed RETURN PASS
  map `docs/build/tools/record_policy/return_pass.toml` (`return_pass.py
  check` green — 278 obligations evaluated, 193 owed, each in exactly one home;
  89 table rows; 116 `[[row.legs]]` entries) and the generated RETURN PASS
  region of `docs/build/LEDGER.md`; head-bound CI boundary records under
  `docs/build/reports/ci/`; PHASE LOG entries; the generated acceptance report
  `docs/build/reports/acceptance/11C.md` and its probe-run record
  `11C-probe-run.json` (suppressed).
- Independence check actually run: the generated `acceptance/11C.md` per-row
  layer table was **diffed row-by-row against the layers re-derived from the
  current BUILD_INDEX cells** — agreement on all 77 rows it covers; the table
  below is derived from head-bound state, not regenerated from the stale
  2026-11-05 input hashes.
- Verdict vocabulary per the ticket: `ACCEPTED` / `UNMET` / `OUT-OF-SCOPE` /
  `DEFERRED`, each labelled by its BM-STATUS-01 layer: `engineered`,
  `fixture-verified`, `staging-verified`, `live-executed`, `public`,
  `human-completed`, plus the artifact class (`seal-verified` on P36.79, the
  same class P38.1a counted as `artifact-verified` for P35.61–P35.64).
- A row whose engineering landed under a head-bound green CI boundary is
  ACCEPTED at the landed layer; a live/public/human criterion whose leg or
  decision remains queued is `DEFERRED` — named by leg id / deferral id, never
  smoothed into the landed verdict.
